t: Flomasta MDPE 20mm x 1/2" push-fit wall plate elbow provides a quick and reliable connection between MDPE pipe to fixed outlets. Push-fit elbow offers tool-free installation, creating a secure, leak-free 90° connection. Demountable design ensures durable, long-lasting performance. Features stainless steel teeth for a strong grip, and an anti-debris seal to protect the internal mechanism from blockages. Compatible with poly pipe systems.
b: Suitable for Domestic Cold Water Systems
